teaching.title: Fractions, Decimals, and Percents Concepts: Vocabulary
teaching.definition: A decimal is a number that is written with a decimal point and place values less than one to the right of the decimal point.
teaching.explanation: Decimals are special fractions that have 10 or a power of 10 equal parts in the whole.
